Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1250348 (Myc proto-oncogene protein). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary using tid, and join activities to compound_structures and molecule_dictionary via molregno. Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
